BillHeading.Sponsors: Representatives Volz, Riccelli, Graham, Vick, Walsh, McCaslin, Griffey, Barkis, Shea, and Ormsby
BillHeading.BriefDescription: Providing that usury laws apply to interest, penalties, and costs imposed on certain delinquent property taxes.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to providing that usury laws apply to interest, penalties, and costs imposed on certain delinquent property taxes; and repealing RCW 19.52.140.

BillSectionHeader.P: RCW 19.52.140 (Chapter not applicable to interest, penalties, or costs on delinquent property taxes) and 1981 c 322 s 8 are each repealed.
